name: Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd.
summary: Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd. engages in the production and sale of condiments, food and agricultural products, and beverages in China. The company offers soybean paste, soy sauce, flavoured sauce, oyster sauce, vinegar, cooking wine, and compound seasonings. It also engages in packaging materials and glass bottles packaging and catering services. It also engages in foodscience research. The company exports its products worldwide. The company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Foshan, China. Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Guangdong Haitian Group Co., Ltd.
